in_marathi.name: Jyotindri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyotindri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jyotindri is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'jyoti' (light) and 'indri' (goddess or ruler). In Hindu mythology, Jyotindri is the goddess of light and knowledge, believed to bestow wisdom and illumination upon her devotees. She is often depicted holding a lamp or a torch in her hands, symbolizing the dispeller of darkness and ignorance.
